name: Sincé (Colombia)
description: Blue field with a white triangle from the hoist reaching the fly and a red triangle at the hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Sincé, a municipality in the department of Sucre, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor. Spanish Wikipedia records the flag as adopted in 1875.

features.role: triangle from the hoist reaching the fly
